title: Stabilize live UX, Market Intel reliability, Alerts persistence wiring, and site-wide content/theme consistency

requirements.summary: Ensure the app uses a single React Query QueryClientProvider so caching and invalidation are consistent across routes.
acceptanceCriteria: The app has exactly one active QueryClientProvider at runtime (no nested providers).
React Query cache keys (e.g., ['marketIntelligence'], ['binarySignal'], ['marketIntelAccess']) are shared consistently across routes and do not reset unexpectedly when navigating.

file_operations.description: Remove the extra QueryClient/QueryClientProvider wrapper from App so React Query is provided only once (via the existing provider in main), eliminating duplicated clients and inconsistent caching across routes.

requirements.summary: Fix animation/transition patterns that hide interactive content after clicks, and ensure reduced-motion users don’t encounter hide-then-reveal behavior for core content.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking/tapping content cards, buttons, tabs, and navigation items does not cause the clicked section/card to become invisible (opacity: 0) or collapse unexpectedly.
Whitepaper chapter navigation does not cause the target section to render hidden after clicking a chapter (no blank content caused by transition state).
Motion respects reduced-motion preferences (no mandatory hide-then-reveal for core content).

file_operations.description: Update animation delay utility classes so they do not set persistent opacity:0; keep delays without forcing content to remain hidden after state changes or re-renders. Also refine reduced-motion overrides to avoid any hide-then-reveal patterns for primary content.

Harden the transition wrapper so it cannot leave children hidden after interactions: ensure pending timeouts are cleared on unmount, and respect reduced-motion by rendering content visible immediately when the user prefers reduced motion.

Adjust chapter-section visibility logic so clicking a chapter never lands on a still-hidden (opacity-0/translated) section; ensure clicked/target section is marked visible immediately and remains readable after navigation.

requirements.summary: Stabilize Market Intel unlock and data loading to reduce avoidable client-side failures and provide clearer error reporting for access vs external API issues.
acceptanceCriteria: After entering a valid passcode and unlocking, selecting an asset and timeframe triggers a successful fetch attempt and renders results when external APIs respond successfully.
If external APIs fail/rate-limit, the UI displays a clear error state that indicates the cause (API failure) and provides a working retry action.
Unlock/lock actions do not leave the Market Intel page stuck in an incorrect locked/unlocked state due to stale cache.

file_operations.description: Improve Market Intel query robustness: add structured client-side error classification (access/auth vs external market API failure vs timeout), ensure retries are reasonable, and return errors with user-actionable metadata for the UI.

Update Market Intel UI to display distinct error states for access/auth problems versus external API failures, and present a reliable retry action that re-attempts the correct query without leaving stale locked/unlocked UI state.

requirements.summary: Remove/isolated simulated randomness from Market Intel calculations and make signals stable over short windows using fetched market data wherever possible.
acceptanceCriteria: Market Intel signals (standard + binary) do not change on every refresh solely due to randomness when the underlying fetched market data is unchanged or nearly unchanged.

Forex market metrics displayed/used in calculations are not generated from pure randomness; if the upstream API cannot provide a metric, it is either omitted from calculations or clearly marked as unavailable in the UI.
Indicator generation does not rely on Date.now-based seeding for its core values.

file_operations.description: Refactor Market Intel computation to remove Math.random and Date.now-based seeding: derive indicator/binary-signal inputs deterministically from fetched market data (with rounding/windowing for short-window stability), and treat unavailable forex metrics as unavailable rather than simulated.

Update Market Intel presentation to clearly indicate when certain forex metrics are unavailable and excluded from calculations, and ensure displayed signals remain stable when upstream market data is unchanged.

requirements.summary: Update Alerts Center frontend to use canister-backed alerts via React Query so alerts persist across refreshes and are scoped to the authenticated user.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating an alert persists it; after a full page refresh, the alert list remains unchanged.
Toggling status and deleting an alert persists and is reflected after refresh.
Alerts are scoped to the authenticated principal (a different Internet Identity does not see another user’s alerts).
UI shows a clear empty state when no alerts exist, and shows loading/error states while fetching/saving.

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for Alerts Center backed by the existing backend actor capabilities (fetch list, create, delete, and status/read updates) and ensure cache invalidation keeps alerts consistent across refreshes and navigation.

Replace client-only alerts state with React Query + actor-backed persistence: implement loading/error/empty states, wire create/delete/status actions to mutations with optimistic UX, and guard interactions behind Internet Identity authentication so alerts are per-user.

requirements.summary: Expand the Whitepaper with multiple new chapters and deeper institutional DeFi content while preserving chapter navigation UX and correct active-chapter tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Whitepaper chapter list includes multiple new chapters (not just minor edits to existing ones).
Clicking each chapter scrolls to a visible section with content (no blank/hidden sections).
The active chapter highlight updates correctly while scrolling through both existing and new chapters.

file_operations.description: Add multiple new whitepaper chapters and full English content sections (headings, paragraphs, bullet lists) in an institutional DeFi tone, while keeping the current sidebar navigation UX and ensuring active-chapter highlighting works for all chapters.

requirements.summary: Apply cohesive theme consistency across Insights, Testimonials, Security/Transparency, Community Highlights, and Ecosystem Growth pages without removing existing content.
acceptanceCriteria: Insights, Testimonials, Security/Transparency, Community Highlights, and Ecosystem Growth share a consistent design language (background, card style, headings, and buttons).
No page appears visually 'older' or mismatched compared to the others (consistent use of the same core layout primitives and styling tokens).

file_operations.description: Add/adjust shared institutional styling utilities (layout spacing, consistent card wrappers, hover states, and motion defaults) to be reused by the listed pages, ensuring consistent typography and background treatment.
Align Insights page styling (section spacing, card styling, hover states, typography) to the shared institutional theme utilities without removing existing content.
Align Testimonials page styling (carousel card styling, stats cards, headings, spacing, hover/motion behavior) to the shared institutional theme utilities without removing existing content.
Align Security/Transparency page styling (measure cards, metric cards, risk framework rows, CTA buttons) to the shared institutional theme utilities without removing existing content.
Align Community Highlights page styling (stats, achievements, featured members, initiatives, CTA) to the shared institutional theme utilities without removing existing content.
Align Ecosystem Growth page styling (top cards, growth initiatives block, metrics/get involved cards) to the shared institutional theme utilities without removing existing content.

requirements.summary: Add at least two new English content sections to enrich the experience, integrated into existing pages and consistent with the institutional DeFi hub domain.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 2 new, clearly labeled sections are added to appropriate existing pages (e.g., Insights/Testimonials/Security/Ecosystem/Home) without removing current sections.
New sections follow the same styling system and do not introduce broken links or empty routes.

file_operations.description: Add a new, clearly labeled institutional DeFi content section (e.g., methodology/research standards or market structure briefing) integrated into the existing Insights page layout and using the shared styling system.

Add a new, clearly labeled ecosystem-focused content section (e.g., integration pipeline, partner due-diligence framework, or developer enablement overview) integrated into the existing Ecosystem Growth page and using the shared styling system.

requirements.summary: Audit and fix site-wide polling/interval live-update behaviors to prevent duplicate intervals, UI flicker/disappearance, and excessive network calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Periodic updates do not create duplicate intervals after navigation or re-renders.
Real-time sections show stable UI (no flicker/disappear) during refresh cycles.
Network requests for auto-refresh do not multiply unexpectedly over time.

file_operations.description: Remove avoidable duplicate fetch triggers (e.g., manual refetch effects that duplicate React Query’s key-based fetching) and ensure refresh behavior does not multiply network calls over time while maintaining stable UI during auto-refresh cycles.
Harden the simulated live-update loop to guarantee a single interval per mount, reduce flicker-inducing state churn where possible, and ensure the UI remains stable during periodic updates.

Ensure live-update-driven re-renders cannot cause transition wrappers to re-hide content; keep visibility state stable once revealed and prevent delayed timeouts from toggling visibility unexpectedly.
